propositions: Step-budget exhaustion raises LLMRunnerError which is a parent class of UnretryableOutputError, preventing the typed exception catch in CompletionAgentStep.run from matching and routing to recovery
Bounded per-criterion recovery mechanism exists but is unreachable for budget exhaustion because the exception type does not match the catch clause condition
A new LLMBudgetExhaustedError subclass of LLMRunnerError must be introduced and raised from interpret_failure's budget branch to enable type-based routing
The except clause in CompletionAgentStep.run must be extended to catch LLMBudgetExhaustedError and route it to _recover, preserving the budget diagnostic before recovery attempt
Recovery must remain fail-closed: if recovery cannot produce full criterion coverage, the step must still raise rather than produce an unearned pass
The truncation recovery path (UnretryableOutputError + _is_token_exhaustion) must maintain exact current behavior as a regression guarantee
